description: This file contains utility functions for sampling algorithms in Apache Spark, including reservoir sampling, calculation of sampling fractions with high confidence, and bounds for Poisson and Binomial distributions used in sampling guarantees.

classes.name: SamplingUtils
classes.description: Object providing sampling utilities such as reservoir sampling and sampling rate calculations.

classes.name: PoissonBounds
classes.description: Object providing bounds for Poisson distribution to guarantee sample sizes.

classes.name: BinomialBounds
classes.description: Object providing bounds for Binomial distribution to guarantee sample sizes.

methods.name: reservoirSampleAndCount
methods.description: Performs reservoir sampling on an iterator, returning the sample and total input size.

methods.name: computeFractionForSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates a sampling fraction that guarantees a minimum sample size with high probability.

methods.name: getLowerBound
methods.description: Returns a lambda for Poisson distribution such that the probability of exceeding a value is very small.

methods.name: getUpperBound
methods.description: Returns a lambda for Poisson distribution such that the probability of being below a value is very small.

methods.name: getLowerBound
methods.description: Returns a success probability threshold for the Binomial distribution to unlikely exceed a fraction.

methods.name: getUpperBound
methods.description: Returns a success probability threshold for the Binomial distribution to unlikely be below a fraction.
